method: Fresh context per device and skin (skin seeded through the app's own persisted store key). Native Site entry with the round-3 concave traverse, Apply, Close Site, then the plan tools toggle open / closed / reopened by tap or click. After fonts.ready and two frames in each state: the site-provenance text, backing and north-arrow client rectangles from the page's Konva stage, the drawing canvas rectangle, every HUD element rectangle in the plan view, the toggle's resolved colour and background with its WCAG contrast, and a screenshot. Pass requires every annotation rectangle fully inside the canvas and clear of every HUD rectangle, and toggle contrast >= 4.5 in every state. Headless emulation, not a physical phone.
